primary_title: The junctional adhesion molecule 3 (JAM-3) on human platelets is a counterreceptor for the leukocyte integrin Mac-1
decision_basis: The JAM/integrin reviews cite the primary JAM-3 receptor-characterization study showing direct JAM-3 interaction with p150,95/alphaXbeta2 at lower extent than Mac-1, with purified-protein and beta2-heterodimer transfectant support.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the primary paper's lower-extent alphaXbeta2 interaction relative to Mac-1 and purified/heterodimer-transfectant binding context; no autonomous ITGAX relay or SCI inference.

primary_title: Interaction between the integrin Mac-1 and signal regulatory protein alpha (SIRPalpha) mediates fusion in heterologous cells
decision_basis: The myeloid-fusion and vasculitis reviews cite the primary study showing SIRPalpha is a Mac-1 counter-receptor, with recombinant ectodomain adhesion, alphaM I-domain BLI, and heterologous cell-fusion support.
